contexts.text: Angelic choirs which were celebrating the Lord... The celebration was sometimes heard as sweet singing...
There do many pass their time who had been among the more celebrated in the world.
Thy brethren shall celebrate thee () = that the (celestial) Church is pre-eminent above the rest. To be celebrated = to be pre-eminent.
The celebration of the Lord in the Heavens takes place for the most part by choirs.
The glorification of the Lord, that is, the celebration of Him from joy of heart. Signified.
Celebration from joy and gladness, Signified.
This is the very essential of the Church which is to be celebrated, Signified. A feast = the worship of the Church as to celebration, for the celebration took place on the days of the feast.
They celebrate marriages, and lay eggs...
It has been granted to speak... with some who have been celebrated in the literary world...
(At marriages in Heaven) they also celebrate a feast...
They had believed that heavenly joy consists in merely praising and celebrating God.
A voice = the joy of the worship, confession, and celebration of the Lord.
The glorifications and celebrations of the Lord (in Heaven) take place from the Word...
